action.action-desc: Ms. Porter (for herself and Mr. Amodei) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To amend the Federal Credit Union Act to modify the frequency of board of directors meetings, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Credit Union Board Modernization Act.

section.header: Frequency of board of directors meetings
section.text: Section 113 of the Federal Credit Union Act (12 U.S.C. 1761b) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking at least once a month and inserting not less than six times annually, with at least one meeting held during each fiscal quarter,; and
by striking monthly each place such term appears.
